items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Well, I worked around with, uh, around town with, uh, Manny Gabriel.

ctx.x: Uh, were there any other bands in there we could go back to your life after you played, uh, you say you played with Kid Howard there for a while? And then, uh, any other, the more or less Dixieland type bands, or dance bands you played with after that that you can remember?
Well, I worked around with, uh, around town with, uh, Manny Gabriel. Uh-huh. He's in, uh, yeah.
